codingDoctrine.fixAssessment: Root cause: two writers of one live co-op campaign (the host browser checkpoint the live host never folded, and any other browser checkpointing over the host). The live host adopts its own browser checkpoint under its single-writer lock; every other PUT is refused while the host is live; the host browser sends its one delta command (AdvanceDay) before the save that carries the day effects.
codingDoctrine.removed: No new command, frame kind, service, index or timeout; the registry scans its entries; the adoption reuses applyCampaignEvent and the existing publish path; the route keeps one save closure for both branches.
codingDoctrine.scope: 4 product files (route, CampaignHostRegistry, CampaignMatchHost, useCampaignStore.dayActions.ts); useCampaignStore.actions.ts unchanged; 3 test files.

behaviourDelivered.server: PUT /api/campaigns/[id] while a live (registered, not closed) co-op host holds the campaign: an envelope whose body.coopSession is { mode: 'host', matchId: <the live matchId> } saves as before inside CampaignMatchHost.adoptSavedCheckpoint, which folds each event the save appended (the checkpoint) into the host state with applyCampaignEvent and publishes it (guests get a CampaignSnapshot frame); any other PUT answers 409 { kind conflict, reason live-coop-session, recoveryAction, conflictingFields [], currentVersion, current, matchId } (409 { error, kind blocked, reason live-coop-session, matchId } when no record is readable) and writes nothing. With no live host the route calls the same save exactly as before.
behaviourDelivered.client: advanceDay on a co-op campaign with an active host transport sends AdvanceDay { days: 1 } (intentId from the day being left) and waits: an Error frame with that intentId (or a transport error, or a throwing send) toasts "Co-op day advance was refused by the host: <reason>. Nothing was saved." and returns null with nothing computed or saved; a CampaignEvent CampaignDayAdvanced of the campaign leads to refreshAfterCommittedCommand, the pre-advance campaign put back, then the unchanged day pipeline and save. Without a host transport the day runs locally and saves as before, then the existing warning toast.
behaviourDelivered.travelAndUpdateCampaign: unchanged client code; their PUTs are adopted by the live host (server behaviour above)
